name: Banc of California, Inc.
summary: Banc of California, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Banc of California that provides banking and treasury management services in the United States. The company offers deposit products, including checking, savings, money market, demand, and retirement accounts, as well as time deposits, certificates of deposit, and safe deposit boxes.
